system.description:
By touch, you alter fine mechanical details of a machine or object, as intricate as you like: the wards of a lock, a thread, a contact, a tolerance, an engraving, a trigger mechanism, a hinge. The work takes one action turn regardless of complexity; make a COG Check in place of the Hardware Test.

No new material, no new components, and no changes to software, data, or electronic logic - what is mechanically present can be rearranged, nothing more. Each superior success allows one additional change to the same object.

This opens a mechanical lock, not an electronic one; it reshapes a retaining ring, not a security code.
